title: We turned EmbeddingGemma 2 into a speech-to-text model
summary: A technical project that repurposes Google's EmbeddingGemma 2 embedding model into a functioning speech-to-text system, demonstrating creative model adaptation across different modalities.
problem_solved: Converts an embedding model designed for text into a speech recognition system, solving the problem of adapting single-modal models to handle different input types.
why_valuable: Demonstrates innovative model reuse by transforming an embedding model into a speech-to-text system, potentially reducing the need for specialized audio models and expanding what's possible with existing model architectures.
